package.description: Revo Uninstaller helps you to uninstall software and remove unwanted programs easily.

en-US.description: Revo Uninstaller helps you to uninstall software and remove unwanted programs easily.
en-US.longDescription: Revo Uninstaller Free helps you to uninstall software and remove unwanted programs easily. It first runs the program's built-in uninstaller and then scans for leftover data that may still remain in files, folders, and Windows registry entries. It also cleans history and traces, manages startup programs, and removes Windows apps.
en-US.name: Revo Uninstaller

zh-CN.description: Revo Uninstaller 帮助您轻松卸载软件和删除不需要的程序。
zh-CN.longDescription: Revo Uninstaller Free 帮助您轻松卸载软件和删除不需要的程序。它会先运行程序的内置卸载器，然后扫描可能仍然残留的文件、文件夹和 Windows 注册表项等残留数据。它还可以清理历史记录和痕迹、管理开机自启程序，并卸载 Windows 应用。
